_comment: Per-frame comparison settings for tools/conform/run.py. tol: per-channel difference after RGB565 quantisation; frac: fraction of pixels allowed beyond it; edge: ignore colour edges of the reference (1 px). The references come from Mesa OSMesa (RGBA8, undithered); DOS-GL draws RGB565 with the chip's dither. A test's own entry ("t16") may add "pre": RUN.BAT lines for the DOS run only (the Mesa reference never sees them).

combine._why: The G400 combiner's multiplies drop bits ((a*b)>>8 in 86Box's model, which truncates; the datasheet's '16:16:16, saturate, rup' is not settled on silicon), and unit 1's x2 and x4 (modbright) scale the loss of two multiplies in a row: those quads come out a few levels darker than Mesa (worst 25 and 33). x1, ADD and unit 0's x2 stay within 17.

t33._why: Stencil: the software renderer's (8 bits). Matrox cards report none, so their frames would differ from Mesa's by design.

t34._why: Lines and points by OpenGL's rules as llvmpipe applies them (diamond-exit ends, integer widths, the legacy point square). The Matrox back end draws lines as plain quads, so its ends would differ by design.

t34_0._why: Every pixel compared, edges too: lines and points are all edge; positions on a 1/16 grid both renderers share.

t34_1._why: Every pixel compared, edges too: lines and points are all edge; positions on a 1/16 grid both renderers share.

t34_2._why: Every pixel compared, edges too: lines and points are all edge; positions on a 1/16 grid both renderers share.

_default_soft8._why: The software renderer at 8 bits: a fixed 3-3-2 palette, ordered-dithered 4x4, so both frames are compared through imgcmp's 4x4 box (the dither averages back to the colour there).

soft8._why: 8 bits: the destination is read back as a dithered palette level, blended, and dithered again with the same pixel's threshold, so the errors correlate and the 4x4 box no longer averages them away (worst 46 levels on 1.8% of pixels). A property of blending into a dithered 3-3-2 buffer.
8 bits: checkerboards fine enough to change colour at the dither's own scale; their 4x4 averages cannot come back exactly through a 3-3-2 palette (worst 50 levels on 1.5% of pixels).
